messages.subject: Just merged the last required pull request for 2.7.0
parts:
Hi all,

I just merged the last real-work pull request for 2.7.0 Stan. (Before it gets merged, there's a pull request for bumping version numbers and other administrative stuff, but that was the last required pull request before we release.)

I know this last pull request will break RStan and PyStan. I'm planning on helping out with that. But before I tagged, I wanted to make sure all the interfaces are compatible. Once we know that for a fact, I'll tag it. (I figured there's no point in tagging until we're sure we can release it.)




Daniel

> 271 * @param o Output stream for messages.

I can see how saying "o" is for messages and then calling
another stream "msgs" might be confusing! Sorry about the
confusing doc.

o: where the gradient program writes

msgs: where the Stan program that's running will write to
that is, target of the print() statement from a running
Stan program
